sentences.en: On Monday night, the 2024 presidential race officially began with the Iowa caucuses, where the real drama was the fight for second place.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，2024年总统初选随着艾奥瓦州党团会议正式拉开帷幕，真正的戏剧性在于争夺第二名的较量。

sentences.en: Today, Reid Epstein takes us inside one of the caucuses and Shane Goldmacher walks us through the final results.
sentences.zh: 今天，雷德·爱泼斯坦带我们走进其中一个党团会议现场，而肖恩·戈德马赫则为我们梳理最终结果。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, January 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月16日，星期二。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, Reid Epstein.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，雷德·爱泼斯坦。

sentences.en: Hello, Michael.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Nice to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Mr. Caucus himself.
sentences.zh: 党团会议先生本人。

sentences.en: Is that what I'm being called?
sentences.zh: 大家都这么叫我吗？

sentences.en: That's what I saw.
sentences.zh: 我是这么看到的。

sentences.en: That's what I saw on the internet.
sentences.zh: 我在网上看到的。

sentences.en: So, Reid, I want to set the scene for our listeners.
sentences.zh: 那么，雷德，我想为我们的听众交代一下背景。

sentences.en: It's 4.35 p.m.
sentences.zh: 现在是下午4点35分。

sentences.en: here in Des Moines.
sentences.zh: 这里是得梅因。

sentences.en: And in about two and a half hours, Republicans across Iowa are going to caucus.
sentences.zh: 大约两个半小时后，艾奥瓦州各地的共和党人将举行党团会议。

sentences.en: And we are going to join them.
sentences.zh: 我们将加入他们。

sentences.en: But before we do that, we want you to describe what that's actually going to look like.
sentences.zh: 但在我们这么做之前，我们想请你描述一下那到底是什么样的。

sentences.en: Because the last time we did this, and we did it with you four years ago, we focused on the Democratic caucus.
sentences.zh: 因为上次我们做这个的时候，也就是四年前和你一起时，我们聚焦的是民主党党团会议。

sentences.en: Because it was a competitive caucus.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一场竞争激烈的党团会议。

sentences.en: Donald Trump was the president at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时唐纳德·特朗普是总统。

sentences.en: So, the Republican caucus wasn't really the source of much intereSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，共和党党团会议其实并没有引起太多关注。

sentences.en: That's reversed this time around.
sentences.zh: 这次情况完全反过来了。

sentences.en: We are most interested in the Republican caucus.
sentences.zh: 我们最感兴趣的是共和党党团会议。

sentences.en: So, tell us what the Republican caucus is actually going to look like.
sentences.zh: 所以，告诉我们共和党党团会议实际上会是什么样子的。

sentences.en: So, four years ago when we went to a Democratic caucus, we went to a high school gym.
sentences.zh: 四年前我们去参加民主党党团会议时，去的是一个高中体育馆。

sentences.en: And we watched as the supporters for each candidate's group themselves in different parts of the gymnasium.
sentences.zh: 我们看着各个候选人的支持者在体育馆的不同区域自行聚集。

sentences.en: And the candidates that didn't have enough people in their group, those people were released to go support someone else.
sentences.zh: 那些人数不够的候选人的支持者，会被释放去支持其他人。

sentences.en: And so, there was a lot of jostling and persuasion and arm twisting.
sentences.zh: 所以当时有很多推挤、说服和软硬兼施。

sentences.en: Physical wooing in that room.
sentences.zh: 那个房间里充满了身体上的拉拢。

sentences.en: There was yelling and speeches from across the room.
sentences.zh: 房间各处都有人在大喊大叫和发表讲演。

sentences.en: We're not going to see any of that kind of stuff tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚我们不会看到任何那种场面。

sentences.en: The Republican caucus is much simpler.
sentences.zh: 共和党党团会议简单得多。

sentences.en: They will come to these spaces.
sentences.zh: 他们会来到这些场地。

sentences.en: The one that we're going to go to is in a high school gym.
sentences.zh: 我们要去的那个就在一个高中体育馆里。

sentences.en: And they will hear speeches from representatives of the different candidates.
sentences.zh: 他们会听取不同候选人代表的演讲。

sentences.en: And then they'll mark on a piece of paper that they were handed when they came in which candidate they support.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会在进门时拿到的一张纸上勾选他们支持的候选人。

sentences.en: And those pieces of paper will go in a box.
sentences.zh: 那些纸条会被投入一个箱子里。

sentences.en: And then at the end of the evening, the people who are running the precinct will take all the paper and put them out on the table.
sentences.zh: 然后在傍晚结束时，负责基层选区的人会把所有的纸条拿出来摆在桌上。

sentences.en: And anybody who's there who wants to watch the counting, we can watch.
sentences.zh: 任何在现场想观看计票的人都可以观看。

sentences.en: So, just in summary, the Republican caucus, it's less dramatic.
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，共和党党团会议没那么戏剧化。

sentences.en: It's less physical than the Democratic one.
sentences.zh: 比民主党的那场要温和得多。

sentences.en: It's a little bit more resembling a traditional vote.
sentences.zh: 它更类似于传统的投票。

sentences.en: But still very unique with an Iowa twiSt.
sentences.zh: 但仍然带有一点艾奥瓦州的特色，非常独特。

sentences.en: Because it's not just you going into a private booth and voting.
sentences.zh: 因为不仅仅是你走进一个私密投票间去投票。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Talk to us before we head out about where the drama, where the suspense really is tonight and where it is not.
sentences.zh: 在我们出发前，给我们讲讲今晚真正的戏剧性和悬念在哪里，又在哪里没有。

sentences.en: Well, where it is not is who's going to finish firSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没有悬念的是谁会获得第一名。

sentences.en: Everybody in Iowa, all the polls have landed on the position that Donald Trump is going to win the Iowa caucuses tonight.
sentences.zh: 艾奥瓦州的每个人，所有的民调都一致认为唐纳德·特朗普将在今晚赢得艾奥瓦州党团会议。

sentences.en: And what everyone is looking for is who finishes second.
sentences.zh: 大家都在关注的是谁能获得第二名。

sentences.en: Is it Nikki Haley, who has made a late charge in Iowa?
sentences.zh: 是最近在艾奥瓦州奋起直追的妮基·黑利？

sentences.en: Or will it be Ron DeSantis, who for months has staked his entire campaign on doing well in Iowa?
sentences.zh: 还是几个月来把整个竞选押宝在艾奥瓦州表现良好的罗恩·德桑蒂斯？

sentences.en: And Reed, we gave you the assignment to pick a caucus location for us to go to tonight.
sentences.zh: 雷德，我们给你的任务是挑选一个今晚我们要去的党团会议地点。

sentences.en: And I'm guessing that you picked a place that is central to the who comes into second place question.
sentences.zh: 我猜你选了一个紧扣“谁能获得第二名”这个核心问题的地方。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We're going to go to a caucus at Van Meter High School in Van Meter, Iowa.
sentences.zh: 我们要去艾奥瓦州范米特的范米特高中参加党团会议。

sentences.en: It's a suburb about a half hour west of downtown Des Moines.
sentences.zh: 这是一个位于得梅因市中心以西约半小时车程的郊区。

sentences.en: And it's a place that's on the edge of rural Iowa where Donald Trump has run very strong,
sentences.zh: 这个地方处于乡村艾奥瓦的边缘，唐纳德·特朗普在那里表现非常强劲，

sentences.en: but also is in commuting distance of Des Moines and should have a lot of professional class voters who are the type of people that Ron DeSantis and Nikki Haley have been targeting.
sentences.zh: 但它也在得梅因的通勤圈内，应该有很多专业阶层选民，而这正是罗恩·德桑蒂斯和妮基·黑利一直拉拢的目标群体。

sentences.en: So Van Meter is the kind of suburb where voters are interested, we think, in a Trump alternative, therefore a good place to assess this question of Haley versus DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 所以范米特是那种选民可能对特朗普替代人选感兴趣的郊区，因此是评估黑利对阵德桑蒂斯这一问题的绝佳地点。

sentences.en: If they're not interested in a Trump alternative in a place like this, then those two are in real big trouble.
sentences.zh: 如果连在这样一个地方他们对特朗普的替代人选都不感兴趣，那这两人可就真的遇到大麻烦了。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: The call was made startlingly early.

sentences.en: And I believe that was the case in many parts of Iowa.

sentences.en: What should we make of that?

sentences.zh: 现在，艾奥瓦州的投票站远没有关闭。

sentences.en: And even in his speech later tonight, Ron DeSantis said, you know, they're through the kitchen sink at us here,

sentences.zh: 我认为他们不满的是，这是他将整个竞选活动押注的州，他们将人们动员到投票站。

sentences.en: They've got them out in sub-freezing conditions to show up at these caucus sites.

sentences.en: And, again, this is not a regular election.

sentences.en: When we were talking to the campaigns in recent days, they thought, really cold, less people will turn out.
sentences.zh: 我们最近几天与各竞选团队交谈时，他们认为天气这么冷，投票率会降低。

sentences.en: And for months, the Trump people and others have said, the bigger the turnout, the better it is for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，特朗普的人和其他人一直说，投票率越高，对唐纳德·特朗普越有利。

sentences.en: Right now, we're looking at something like 110,000 people are going to a vote.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们看到大约有11万人在投票。

sentences.en: A low turnout in the end.
sentences.zh: 最终投票率很低。

sentences.en: A very low turnout.
sentences.zh: 投票率非常低。

sentences.en: They were talking about 220, 215, 200,000.
sentences.zh: 他们之前谈论的是22万、21.5万、20万。

sentences.en: So you're talking about the electorate was what they thought was going to be unfavorable to him.
sentences.zh: 所以你们在谈论的是他们认为对我不利的选民群体。

sentences.en: And he's still winning, running away.
sentences.zh: 而他依然大胜。

sentences.en: Right, because a low turnout, Iowa caucus still turned out to be a landslide victory for Trump.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为低投票率的爱荷华州党团会议最终还是成了特朗普的大胜。

sentences.en: It really raises the question is, is there any kind of turnout right now that isn't a landslide for Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 这确实引发了一个问题，现在还有什么样规模的投票率对唐纳德·特朗普来说不是压倒性胜利吗？

sentences.en: Talk to us just for a little bit about not just the geography of his victory.
sentences.zh: 跟我们聊聊，不仅是关于他胜利的地理范围。

sentences.en: You already mentioned that he won basically almost every county in the state, but about the demographics of it and what that reveals about him and his opponents in this race.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到他几乎赢了该州的所有郡，还要谈谈它的人口统计数据，以及这揭示了他和本次竞选中的对手们的什么情况。

sentences.en: So the demographic data is a little bit less clear than just the vote totals.
sentences.zh: 因此，人口统计数据比单纯的选票总数要稍微模糊一些。

sentences.en: But what they show is a similar story, which is that Donald Trump was winning.
sentences.zh: 但它们显示了一个相似的故事，那就是唐纳德·特朗普在获胜。

sentences.en: He was winning among men.
sentences.zh: 他在男性中获胜。

sentences.en: He was winning among women.
sentences.zh: 他在女性中获胜。

sentences.en: He was winning among older people.
sentences.zh: 他在老年人中获胜。

sentences.en: He was doing well among middle-aged people.
sentences.zh: 他在中年人中表现很好。

sentences.en: He was doing the strongest among voters who didn't attend college, which is not a surprise.
sentences.zh: 他在没有上过大学的选民中表现最强劲，这并不令人意外。

sentences.en: Not a big surprise because we know that non-college-educated voters have long been a part of Trump's base.
sentences.zh: 这并不太意外，因为我们知道没有受过大学教育的选民长期以来都是特朗普的基本盘。

sentences.en: Yes, but he was winning a pretty big share of college-educated Republicans too.
sentences.zh: 是的，但他也赢得了相当大一部分受过大学教育的共和党人。

sentences.en: There's really not places where he's losing.
sentences.zh: 实际上没有哪个地方他在失利。

sentences.en: Now, even his weakest parts demographically of the Republican Party, he's basically tied with his opponents where he's weakeSt.
sentences.zh: 现在，即使在共和党内人口统计最弱的地区，他在最弱的地方也基本上与对手打成平手。

sentences.en: And so the challenge has been for Nikki Haley, yes, you have performed more strongly in highly educated suburban areas.
sentences.zh: 因此，对妮基·黑利来说，挑战在于，是的，你在高学历郊区表现更强劲。

sentences.en: And those areas, you're fighting Donald Trump to like a draw, right?
sentences.zh: 在这些地区，你和唐纳德·特朗普激战成平手，对吧？

sentences.en: And then you go out to the most rural areas, the places where maybe the most conservative parts of the state, the Northwest, and dominated by Donald Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 然后你走到最乡村的地区，那些可能是该州最保守的地区，西北部，由唐纳德·特朗普主导，对吧？

sentences.en: Ron DeSantis, Nikki Haley, they're not close to him in those areas.
sentences.zh: 罗恩·德桑蒂斯、妮基·黑利，他们在这些地区都望尘莫及。

sentences.en: And so if this is what the map looks like here, what's it going to look like everywhere else?
sentences.zh: 所以如果这里的地图是这样的，其他地方会是什么样？

sentences.en: Well, Shane, to that point, let's turn to DeSantis and to this competition for second place.
sentences.zh: 好吧，谢恩，就这一点而言，让我们转向德桑蒂斯和这场第二名的竞争。

sentences.en: Because it's kind of hard to know what to make of a second-place DeSantis finish that is so distant from Trump's finish.
sentences.zh: 因为很难理解德桑蒂斯获得第二名，却与特朗普的差距如此之大，到底意味着什么。

sentences.en: And that also is like second place by a hair, right?
sentences.zh: 而且这也是千钧一发的第二名，对吧？

sentences.en: Two percentage points.
sentences.zh: 两个百分点。

sentences.en: So what do we make of it?
sentences.zh: 那我们该如何看待它？

sentences.en: I mean, I think the problem for him is that it really doesn't resolve the question of second place.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为对他的问题在于，这确实没有解决第二名的问题。

sentences.en: You have to remember that this is a state that he predicted he could win in.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，这是一个他预测自己能够获胜的州。

sentences.en: Win outright.
sentences.zh: 直接获胜。

sentences.en: Win outright.
sentences.zh: 直接获胜。

sentences.en: Be Trump.
sentences.zh: 击败特朗普。

sentences.en: He is the most organized campaign in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 他在爱荷华州拥有组织得最严密的竞选团队。

sentences.en: He spent the most time here.
sentences.zh: 他在这里花的时间最多。

sentences.en: And he's yet getting less than half the vote that Donald Trump has gotten.
sentences.zh: 然而他得到的选票还不到唐纳德·特朗普的一半。

sentences.en: And so where does it leave his candidacy?
sentences.zh: 那么这让他的候选人资格何去何从？

sentences.en: It leaves him ahead of Nikki Haley.
sentences.zh: 这让他领先于妮基·黑利。

sentences.en: But so far behind Donald Trump that it is hard to see where he goes next.
sentences.zh: 但落后唐纳德·特朗普太多，以至于很难看出他下一步要去哪里。

sentences.en: The next state in the calendar is New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 日程表上的下一个州是新罕布什尔州。

sentences.en: And it's been the early state he's pulled most weekly in.
sentences.zh: 那也是他在早期各州中民调最差的州。

sentences.en: And so I think a notable decision, he is flying tonight not directly to New Hampshire but directly to South Carolina, which is actually Nikki Haley's home state.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是一个值得注意的决定，他今晚不直接飞往新罕布什尔州，而是直接飞往南卡罗来纳州，那实际上是妮基·黑利的家乡。

sentences.en: And which is not voting until?
sentences.zh: 而那里的投票要等到什么时候？

sentences.en: A month from now.
sentences.zh: 一个月后。

sentences.en: Which is a long ways away.
sentences.zh: 那还有很长一段时间。

sentences.en: And then he's going to go up to New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 然后他要再去新罕布什尔州。

sentences.en: So he's not giving up on New Hampshire, but he's giving a pretty clear symbol that he's not planning on going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以他没有放弃新罕布什尔州，但他发出了一个非常清晰的信号，即他不打算退出。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And is stuck in a kind of muddled battle for second place with Nikki Haley, who came in a close third.
sentences.zh: 并陷入了与妮基·黑利争夺第二名的混乱之战，后者以微弱劣势获得第三名。

sentences.en: And in a lot of ways, her experience, right, Shane, has been the exact opposite of DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，谢恩，她的经历恰恰与德桑蒂斯相反。

sentences.en: When we think about trajectory, he enters the race with huge expectations all the way back to a year ago.
sentences.zh: 当我们回想轨迹时，他带着极高的期望进入竞选，一直追溯到一年前。

sentences.en: We've talked to you about this a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们跟你讨论过很多次。

sentences.en: That somebody who would be, lots of people thought, the real viable challenger to Trump, which hasn't really happened.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为会成为特朗普真正的强劲挑战者的人，并没有真正出现。

sentences.en: Haley entered this race as somebody around which there were not a lot of expectations.
sentences.zh: 黑利进入这场竞选时，并没有受到太多期望。

sentences.en: She pulled in the single digits for months and months.
sentences.zh: 她的民调连续好几个月都在个位数徘徊。

sentences.en: So whereas DeSantis' experience culminating here is one of disappointment, is it right to see Haley's performance, even though it was a third place one, as something of a success?
sentences.zh: 因此，既然德桑蒂斯的经历以这里的失望告终，那么把黑利虽然获得第三名的表现看作是一种成功，对吗？

sentences.en: You know, I think it's a disappointment because of where she was recently.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这是一个失望，因为她最近的处境。

sentences.en: Which is the last poll, the poll that people watched most closely, it's called the Iowa poll, and it showed her in second place.
sentences.zh: 也就是最后一次民调，人们最关注的民调，被称为爱荷华州民调，它显示她排在第二位。

sentences.en: And so she didn't achieve that metric.
sentences.zh: 所以她没有达到这个标准。

sentences.en: And more importantly, by falling behind Ron DeSantis, she lost the argument that she wanted to make that he should get out of the race.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，由于落后于罗恩·德桑蒂斯，她失去了她一直想表达的论点，即他应该退选。

sentences.en: She's trying to frame this up as it's her versus Trump.
sentences.zh: 她正试图将其构建为她与特朗普的对决。

sentences.en: And Ron DeSantis is like, you know, I finished ahead of you here.
sentences.zh: 而罗恩·德桑蒂斯则像是，你知道的，我在这里排在你前面。

sentences.en: Like, you can't quite push me out of the race yet.
sentences.zh: 就像，你还不能把我挤出竞选一样。

sentences.en: Is there any way in which she's correct, knowing what's about to happen in the next couple of states?
sentences.zh: 结合接下来几个州即将发生的事情，她有任何可能是对的吗？

sentences.en: You know, I think the biggest winner here, you know, where we started, it's Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这里最大的赢家，就像我们开始时说的，是特朗普，对吧？

sentences.en: You continue to have this fight for second place.
sentences.zh: 你们依然在进行这场第二名的争夺战。

sentences.en: His goal is a divided Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 他的目标是一个分裂的共和党。

sentences.en: Because if there's one weak spot for him in the results from Iowa, it's that while he won overwhelmingly compared to where his rivals were, he had about half the vote.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他在爱荷华州的结果中有什么软肋的话，那就是虽然与他的对手相比他以压倒性优势获胜，但他只获得了大约一半的选票。

sentences.en: Which means about half the voters could conceivably have voted for somebody else if they all consolidated behind one person.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果所有人都团结在一个人身后，大约一半的选民完全有可能投给别人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Look, for every Republican who wants to beat Donald Trump, the math is really clear in this race, which is you just need one opponent.
sentences.zh: 听着，对于任何想要击败唐纳德·特朗普的共和党人来说，这场竞选的算术非常明确，那就是你只需要一个对手。

sentences.en: That if you have two serious opponents running against him, there's virtually no chance of beating him for the nomination.
sentences.zh: 如果你有两个严肃的对手与他竞争，几乎没有机会在提名战中击败他。

sentences.en: And what the results tonight mean is that there's still going to be two.
sentences.zh: 今晚的结果意味着依然会有两个对手。

sentences.en: And that's why Nikki Haley's third place finish is a disappointment for her.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么妮基·黑利获得第三名对她来说是一个失望。

sentences.en: She's close to Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 她离罗恩·德桑蒂斯很近。

sentences.en: This is in some ways a decent showing for her.
sentences.zh: 从某些方面来看，这对她来说是个不错的表现。

sentences.en: But she had a chance here, if she vaulted far ahead of him, to push him out of the race entirely.
sentences.zh: 但她本来有机会在这里大跨步领先，从而将他完全挤出竞选。

sentences.en: But right now, this split result is basically exactly what the Trump campaign would have hoped for in the last few days.
sentences.zh: 但现在，这个分裂的结果基本上正是特朗普竞选团队在过去几天里所希望看到的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In that sense, it feels like this was a double victory in Iowa for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，感觉这对于唐纳德·特朗普来说是爱荷华州的双重胜利。

sentences.en: The first victory being 51% of the vote, a landslide.
sentences.zh: 第一场胜利是获得51%的选票，压倒性的大胜。

sentences.en: But the second victory being that he left his two main rivals with scraps.
sentences.zh: 但第二场胜利是，他给他的两个主要对手只留下了残羹冷炙。

sentences.en: Yeah, and they're fighting over the scraps with each other, which is exactly what his team has been looking for throughout this race.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们正在互相争夺残羹冷炙，这正是他的团队在整个竞选过程中一直期待的。

sentences.en: And so when I think about this win in Iowa, I think it's not just a first step.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我想到在爱荷华州的这场胜利时，我认为这不仅仅是第一步。

sentences.en: It's a really big first step toward becoming the Republican nominee for the third consecutive election.
sentences.zh: 这是连续第三次成为共和党总统候选人迈出真正巨大的一步。

sentences.en: Well, Shane, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢恩，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.zh: 并在红海重创了一艘美国商船，

sentences.zh: 这大大升级了他们对一条至关重要的全球航运路线的袭击。

sentences.en: The latest round of attacks suggests that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 最新一轮袭击表明，美国及其盟友目前无力阻止胡塞武装。

sentences.en: and its allies are so far powerless to stop the Houthis.
sentences.zh: 上周，一个由美国领导的联盟对也门境内的胡塞武装发动了数十次空袭。

sentences.en: Last week, an American-led coalition carried out dozens of airstrikes against the Houthis inside Yemen.
sentences.zh: 但这些袭击似乎反而助长了该组织的嚣张气焰。

sentences.en: But those attacks appear to have only emboldened the group.
sentences.zh: 得到伊朗支持的胡塞武装声称，他们袭击西方船只是在抗议以色列对哈马斯的战争。

sentences.en: The Houthis, who are backed by Iran, claim that they're targeting Western ships in protest of Israel's war against Hamas.
